question: In which texts is it declared that a curse was obtained, and in what manner is that declaration repeated?
premises: A repeated locative refers to a tantra.
A curse is mentioned as object obtained.
A declaration is said to have been made as stated.
inference: In tantra after tantra it has been declared that a curse was indeed obtained.
uncertainties: The agent who obtained the curse is not named in this verse.
plain_english: In tantra, in tantra, it has been declared that, as stated, a curse was indeed obtained.
